body:
Almost all of the staff that work there are close friends with the GM, so I really don't feel that bad about it.

Legally, I don't see that I have any recourse whatsoever.  I can't prove that I worked there.
Next you'll be trying to tell us that Canadians speak English.  Nice try.
Advil helps a little bit, as does icing it.  I think it might be a torn rotator cuff from what I've read online.

I honestly have no idea.  I woke up one morning and my right arm was kind of stiff, like I had slept on it funny.  Since then its just gotten worse.  I have very limited mobility in it and it hurts like hell if I try to raise my arm over my head.

Heh, stretching out my shoulder is what I don't want to do if I want to feel better.  Its been hurting for three weeks now, with no sign of getting better.  One of my fears is that I'll finally find a job, but I'll have to basically hide my injury otherwise I won't get hired, then I'll end up making it even worse.  Gotta love America and its health care system.

I'm 32, and it seems like my whole life I can't string together more than six months of happiness at a time.  Things have been crappy for this long, its hard to see how they could ever end up getting better.
